watch.summary: While the streamer distractedly looks around to inspect his next path in a physics platformer, his egg character starts rolling backward off the plank.

beats.what: Streamer tells the egg to stop being wobbly and let him look around.
Streamer thanks the egg for settling down and points at the obstacles ahead.
The egg suddenly begins rolling backward off the wooden board.
Streamer realizes the egg is falling and screams in panic.
Streamer complains in disbelief as the egg continues to slide down.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Hey! No! No! Wait, wait, wait, wait!
watch.why: The comedic timing of the egg falling the exact second he takes his focus off it creates a classic instant-regret scenario. His frantic reaction adds to the relatable frustration of playing difficult physics games.
